title: OpenAI introduces dots, always-on ChatGPT agents with their own cloud computer and browser
detail: As documented on 2026-11-21, dots are rolling out gradually to eligible Pro and Business Premium accounts and are generally available in eligible Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces, where access has been on by default since 2026-11-18 unless a workspace opts out. ChatGPT Wallet launched in dots on 2026-11-13, and OpenAI's help article says it works only in conversations with a dot.

title: American Express publishes its Intent Intelligence framework
detail: A Create Intent API, an Intent ID and a Proof of Intent Token (a JSON Web Token) that can scope the agent's payment credential to the authenticated intent; part of the ACE Developer Kit, whose program page lists the Intent Intelligence specification as available since 2026-04-14.

title: ChatGPT Wallet launches in dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers
detail: As read 2026-11-21, OpenAI's post names American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa as partners, with Chase taking part as a card issuer; the launch-day text and launch-day coverage named the three networks only. The user approves each purchase with a biometric check, and a payment token, which the post says the payment network provides, goes into the merchant's existing checkout. OpenAI's help article (updated 2026-11-19) says Wallet works only in conversations with a dot, not in Chat, Work or standalone Codex threads, although the post's description names Work and Codex. OpenAI does not present Wallet as ACP; its post quotes American Express calling Wallet its first ACE integration.
